body.message:
Good morning Jason,

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

We want to confirm this issue is from the building side, not within the apartment itself. We have followed up multiple times via email and directly with reception, and the owner has also raised it through the DAMAC app. We are currently awaiting an update from the DAMAC team and are pushing for the fastest possible resolution.

We understand the urgency. We will update you as soon as we hear back.

Thank you for your patience.
